claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 accurately captures the general permission for small quantity and large quantity generators to accumulate non-acute and acute hazardous waste in satellite accumulation areas up to the specified quantity thresholds without a permit, provided all rule conditions are satisfied.

Claim C0001 faithfully extracts the generator's option to comply with satellite accumulation exemption conditions in this rule instead of central accumulation conditions, subject to the exceptions in (A)(7) and (A)(8).

Claim C0002 correctly reflects the generator's immediate duties when a satellite container is not in good condition or begins to leak, including the alternatives of re-containment or transfer to an authorized central accumulation area.
Claim C0003 correctly states the container compatibility standard under paragraph (A)(2) as a condition of satellite accumulation exemption.
Claim C0004 accurately reflects the prohibition against co-locating incompatible wastes or materials in the same container unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 is met.

Claim C0005 accurately represents the prohibition against placing hazardous waste into an unwashed container that previously held incompatible waste or material without complying with rule 3745-65-17(B).
Claim C0006 correctly sets forth the requirement to separate or protect containers holding hazardous waste from nearby incompatible wastes or materials by practical means.

Claim C0007 comprehensively preserves the general closed-container duty during satellite accumulation and all three enumerated exceptions: waste handling, equipment operation venting, and safety/pressure venting.
Claim C0008 correctly covers both marking requirements for satellite accumulation containers: labeling with 'Hazardous Waste' and indicating the hazards of the contents.

Claim C0009 completely captures the three-consecutive-calendar-day compliance options when satellite accumulation exceeds volume thresholds, including CAA compliance or removal to CAA, on-site facility, or off-site facility.
Claim C0010 correctly retains both obligations governing the interim three-day period: continued compliance with (A)(1) to (A)(5) and dating containers with the start date of excess accumulation.
Claim C0011 faithfully extracts the small quantity generator preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure cross-references under paragraph (A)(7).
Claim C0012 faithfully extracts the large quantity generator preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures mandate under paragraph (A)(8).
Claim C0013 accurately preserves the informational rule comment pointing to rule 3745-50-11 for incorporated material dates.

unit_judgments.rationale: The satellite accumulation authorization and governing limits are fully expressed in C0000.

The prohibition against placing hazardous waste into unwashed containers previously holding incompatible materials is fully stated in C0005.
The separation and protection standard for nearby incompatible waste containers is fully covered in C0006.
The general obligation to keep containers closed during satellite accumulation is covered in C0007.
The exception for opening containers when adding, removing, or consolidating waste is explicitly retained in C0007.
The exception for temporary venting necessary for equipment operation is explicitly preserved in C0007.
The exception for temporary venting necessary to prevent pressure build-up or dangerous situations is explicitly preserved in C0007.
The requirement to label containers with the words 'Hazardous Waste' is fully captured in C0008.
The requirement to mark or label containers with hazard indications and illustrative standards is fully captured in C0008.
The option to comply with central accumulation requirements within three consecutive calendar days of exceeding limits is covered in C0009.
The option to remove excess waste within three calendar days to a central accumulation area is covered in C0009.
The option to remove excess waste within three calendar days to an on-site permitted or permit-by-rule facility is covered in C0009.
The option to remove excess waste within three calendar days to an off-site designated facility is covered in C0009.
The requirement to continue complying with satellite rules and date the containers during the three-day excess period is fully captured in C0010.
Preparedness, prevention, and emergency requirements for small quantity generator satellite accumulation areas are covered in C0011.
Preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures for large quantity generator satellite accumulation areas are covered in C0012.
The reference citation comment is accurately captured in C0013.
